title: When tomato ketchup was sold as medicine in 1830s America

title: Ancient Maya's red pigment left toxic mercury legacy, new study finds
content: Ancient Maya civilization used a red pigment made of mercury-rich cinnabar for decoration and rituals. This practice led to significant mercury contamination of nearby lakes and ecosystems. Research indicates that rising mercury levels impacted aquatic organisms and may have affected human health. Previous studies have also shown similar contamination at various Maya sites, raising concerns about widespread environmental impact.

content: Donovan Atkinson, 5, from attleboro, Massachusetts, has sold more than 500 jars since setting up his stand in 2025 . his family grew more cucumbers than they could readily use in their garden . instead of letting the extra produce go to waste, he started experimenting with making pickles at home .
